rendered: The film thicknesses tested electrochemically were ∼80 nm[1] and ∼40 nm[2] V2O5 films. The thicker film, the ∼80 nm[3] coating, was made with 1000 ALD cycles[4], as stated in the Figure 3[5] caption. The document does not give the ALD cycle count for the thinner film in the main text. On potential shifts, the paper reports a strain-induced shift of ∼40 mV[6] in the average equilibrium potential, and says that similar shifts in values of ΔEeq(avg) were observed[7] for both films, so the potential shifts did not differ meaningfully between the thicker and thinner films.
